body:
Found by T232's suppression lens (2026-08-25), named in
test/federation/curse-authority.test.ts's header, not fixed there. The lift branch of
curseChannelLawImpl (src/federation/channel.ts ~1906-1924) revives a binding by walking
`negationsOf(binding.id)` and skipping any negation that itself carries a negation
(`if (negationsOf(negationId).length > 0) continue`) — a PRESENCE check with no author filter and
no lawful-survival closure. This is the exact shape T232 just corrected for the curse RECORD,
still present for the binding STRIKE.

The failing shape: operator curses Plant (an operator-authored binding-strike nb); a non-operator
lands ns = a negation of nb in the same ground; operator lifts. The loop sees
negationsOf(nb).length > 0 and treats nb as already-lifted, so it SKIPS appending the operator's
lawful lift-negation. The runner resolves the binding through lawfulNegated, under which ns is
inert, so nb still survives and the re-minted (same-id) binding stays born-dead — the lift
silently fails to revive the lens. Direction is UNDER-serve (no resurrection), not disclosure.

WHY IT WAS DEFERRED, not folded: the one-line fix (read the loop's skip through lawfulNegated,
matching the curse-record fix) is cheap, but an honest two-sided rail turns on whether a
non-operator negation can REACH the §47.4 pool ground where the binding-strike lives — a
reachability the lens could not settle, and T217's discipline warns against a rail built on a
possibly-unreachable shape. This ticket owns settling that reachability, then either building the
fix with a real two-sided rail or documenting the shape as constructively unreachable.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The reachability is settled: either a fixture reaches the lift's skip with a non-operator
    negation of the binding-strike (then the fix + a two-sided rail — the lawful lift revives the
    lens while a stranger's negation cannot suppress the revival), OR the ticket documents why a
    non-operator delta cannot reach the pool binding's ground, closing it as a comment. Verify:
    the fixture or the reachability argument in the PR.
(b) If built: the lift's two halves (curse-record read and binding-revival read) share one
    lawful-survival discipline. Verify: new test in test/federation/curse-authority.test.ts is
    frozen — a NEW file, or the reachability doc.

Merge tier: repair — the reader stops honoring a strike the constitution never authorized (same
class as T232). Self-merge on the ordinary bar if built; the reachability-only outcome is a docs
close.
title: The curse-lift's binding revival keeps an author-blind presence check
